approved_instruction: Define AR_hat(z) = unit(AR(z)) and use E(z; h) = ||unit(h) - AR_hat(z)||^2.

degenerate_vector_policy.rule: A non-finite, non-rank-1, shape-mismatched, or L2-norm-at-most-epsilon input makes the measurement invalid; it is never assigned a finite reconstruction error.

changed: all frozen calibration and downstream result artifacts
unchanged: FineWeb document split and shuffled-activation mapping

rationale: The released AR was optimized after L2-normalizing both prediction and target. Its raw output scale is therefore not identified by that objective. Directional error measures the geometry the checkpoint learned and prevents arbitrary AR-output norm from dominating reconstruction matching.
artifact_policy: The original preregistration and its SHA-256 remain immutable. Existing upstream artifacts in the unchanged scope remain admissible. Any cache or result containing a reconstruction error must carry this amendment's SHA-256 and use the active formula; pre-amendment reconstruction-error artifacts are incompatible and must not be reused.
calibration_policy: Thresholds remain frozen once from the FineWeb calibration split and its preregistered shuffled-activation controls only. No OOD evaluation may tune or recalibrate this metric.
